methods.label: Use the definition of a logarithm
methods.explanation:
To identify the logarithm's base, rewrite the equation with a single quantity raised to \(x\). Since \(7^x>0\), division by \(7^x\) is valid and gives
\[
7^7=\frac{8^x}{7^x}=\left(\frac87\right)^x.
\]
By definition, \(a^x=N\) is equivalent to \(x=\log_a N\) when \(a>0\), \(a\ne1\), and \(N>0\). Here these conditions hold, so
\[
x=\log_{8/7}(7^7).
\]
Thus \(\boxed{b=\frac87}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
